zori.seasonalMethod: seasonally adjusted by whatchanged (county pattern blended with the state (or U.S.) pattern based on history length)
zori.seasonalDetail: log seasonal factors = w * own + (1 - w) * state pool, w = n / (n + 8), n = fewest leak-free ratios (ratio months <= 2024-06) in any calendar month; pools from series with >= 6 ratios per month; saPool = pool used, saW = w
zori.label: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI), asking rents on new leases
